contract.goal: Finish readable and accessible note workflows on emulators while preserving existing storage, navigation intent and privacy boundaries.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2, accepted clean baseline29482c49d17fc9c6470c0ea964419288b8931f67. Approved independent baseline interface requirements and complete UI refinement item, plus E8 accessible relations. One CP3 presentation/usability task; no new business features.

Inspect actual home/search, editor/title/category selection, category management, recycle/restore and related-note list/confirmations. Fix concrete readability/operability defects at systemfont1.0/1.5/2.0, light/dark, portrait/narrow logical width and IME visible. Body18sp baseline, major targets56dp, scrollable content, no overlapping/truncated essential actions or inaccessible confirmation buttons. Preserve actual empty/search states and existing routes.

Keep primary new/edit/save/search paths clear and existing text recording independent of AI/category/voice. Reduce developer implementation details in note presentation: full UUIDs should not dominate cards/spoken labels; use real title, excerpt and meaningful context for disambiguation, with IDs kept internally/test semantics or optional detail only if useful. Same-title rows must still open exact stableIDs, no fake display data. Do not hide privacy/permission/backup limits or real operational errors.

Accessibility: meaningful Chinese labels/roles/heading/state, one coherent clickable control node, understandable focus order, visible keyboard focus where supported, dialogs restore focus, no color/gesture-only dependency. Check actual platform nodes/actions and measured bounds; inspect screenshots. If an already installed authorized TalkBack is available, run a bounded actual service navigation test and restore prior settings; otherwise report service test gap explicitly, never relabel UiAutomation as TalkBack. No unreviewed service download/installation.

Back/keyboard dismissal/rotation/background and text editing must retain drafts and manual title/category; use actual durable synthetic records and exactID navigation, accidental destructive actions remain confirmed. Existing voice/AI/reminder/backup entry behavior and consent remain unchanged; regressions where editor layout intersects those controls. No persistent fields/schema/backup changes expected.

Work from observed issues, small layout/semantics changes rather than replacing architecture or adding design dependencies. Document before/after issues, actual screen/context identities, final route checks and remaining physical-device limitations. No aesthetic claims without rendered evidence.
out_of_scope: No change to P0/P1, user data boundary or fundamental navigation/three-step intent; no new command/model/provider, theme customization/animation/batch actions/graph, reminder/backup business changes or app-wide unbounded redesign. No private data/device access, accounts/sync/payment/publication, unknown dependencies.
acceptance: All scoped note screens and confirmations operable in actual emulator at tested1.0/1.5/2.0font and light/dark; screenshots and node/bounds evidence expose any unsupported combination rather than mark blanket pass. Clear primary actions, essential text visible/scrollable and touch targets compliant.

Durable editing, categories/trash/restore and relation navigation preserve exact records under keyboard/back/rotation, including same titles. Presentation changes do not alter existing data/consent/command semantics; affected regressions pass.

Actual platform accessibility evidence and any actualTalkBack outcome separately identified. Build/lint plus meaningful affected tests pass. Exact cleancommit/APKs/manifest and issue-to-fix evidence; remaining generalASR/provider/Xiaomi/family gaps retained.
evidence_required: ACK exact task/attempt/hash/baseline. RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED, scoped observed issue list and file purposes; before/after real screenshots with device/font/theme/IME context, platform node/target/focus and route evidence; durable DB assertions, commands/results, final commit/APK/hashmanifest, limitations and next recommendation then stop.
stop_conditions: Complete only this CP3 usability task and report commander; do not begin anotherCheckpoint or private-device acceptance. Preserve unknown edits.

Stop affected action for data loss/consent or workflow scope change, new dependency/service need or inability to validate essential controls. Do not expand into new feature or use superficial screenshot success instead of operation evidence.

contract.goal: Verify and minimally repair readability and operation of existing reminder workflows on synthetic emulators, preserving all reminder behavior.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2 at clean accepted8a98e09d1276a17016a4e71f7f7385f6c57e402c. Baseline UI requirement explicitly includes reminder list; prior notes-only matrix does not cover this. CP7 only.

Inspect actual reminder form, plan list and event history at systemfont1.0/1.5/2.0, light/dark,320dp narrow portrait and IME/rotation. Verify once/daily/weekly multi-day controls, date/time entry, validation errors, enabled/disabled and permission-denied states, save/back, exact-note links and history pagination. Preserve useful error/status meaning and scroll access. Body18sp baseline and primary targets56dp; actual measured nodes and screenshots.

Fix only observed presentation, focus, semantics or state-loss defects. Existing fixed status/error area may consume viewport at large font; reproduce before claiming defect. Verify actual switch/chip selected states and labels, keyboard focus and meaningful disambiguation for same-title plans. No repeated open-ended TalkBack injection research: bounded test only if already available; report actual service gaps separately.

Use real durable synthetic reminders and exact record IDs; verify form persistence after explicit save and existing back semantics, update/cancel rules and notification links unchanged, no duplicated plans or accidental enable. Host algorithms and Android affected regressions; real scheduled single notification if needed for changed path, no claim compressed cycles prove natural recurrence.
out_of_scope: No new repeat types/time slots, exact alarm permission, engine/provider, schema/dependency, notification privacy change or generalized redesign. No other feature UI edits unless minimal required integration. No real-device/private data or family tests; no ASR re-evaluation.
acceptance: Each tested font/theme reminder route remains operable with visible or scrollable essential text/actions; actual settings and node bounds/screenshots recorded. Fix concrete failures without weakening existing behavior.

Exact SQLite and affected notification/scheduling regressions prove existing semantics retained. No private data, new dependency/schema or unreviewed service. Build/lint and meaningful tests pass; zero-source-change delivery acceptable if existing UI proves compliant.

Provide cleancommit and exact APK/test version binding, issue-to-fix evidence and explicit limitations. Keep natural daily/weekly,Xiaomi,family,TalkBack,ASR and provider gaps distinct; not whole-app completion.

stop_conditions: One CP7 task only; finish report then stop. Do not start another checkpoint.

每响应64MiB、全单网络256MiB、连接15秒、尝试含跳转180秒、恢复等候最多10秒、全单30分钟；实际流读取/失败/重试正文计数。使用现有curl/标准库/少量本单辅助配置，不安装或开发平台。

原静态审查根下独占创建attempts/<本合同attempt_id>/artifacts、unpacked、reports，路径/链接/权限检查、不覆盖旧0GET证据。按正式scope安全逐成员流提取，禁止extractall/保留执行位/执行目标；外层每对象10000成员/512MiB展开，全单20000/1GiB，单成员128MiB，实际重读计数；文本2MiB单文件/32MiB全单，初查每对象10分钟。
只初查外层清单、路径/基础结构、LICENSE/NOTICE/可读配置；不递归JAR或加载模型。CRC仅完整读成员验证，未覆盖如实记录；高压缩比warning不单独定恶意，实际越限/损坏/越界仍停止。A非结构证据不足可继续B，硬停止不可。

输出acquisition-ledger.json、runtime-inventory.json、model-inventory.json、stage1-review.md及工具/来源/预算/覆盖证据。每对象basic_inventory_complete/manual_review/block/not_acquired，整体adoption_gate=blocked。失败残片保留不冒充完整对象。
完成后提供身份绑定JSON与报告path/bytes/SHA、网络/展开/时间/CRC覆盖、Git和下一阶段未知。按用户要求回调，优先仅任务完成通知、不附被拒的内部元数据载荷；如自动审批拒绝，不重试或绕过，完整结果留本任务供Leader读取。

首页笔记标题、显著即时搜索、真实分类筛选（当前全部/未分类，不造模块）、两列标题正文日期卡片、清晰新增图标动作；窄屏/大字转单列，主要触控56dp、正文18sp、明暗/长标题/键盘可用。编辑器优先全宽正文和标题日期保存状态，避免卡片套卡片。参考截图仅布局，不读取私人文字。

无假数据/不可用假控件，L1不回归；提交边界和APK身份清楚。

archived_tasks.goal: Implement user-selected read-only Android calendar import into local notes with faithful source provenance, preview, transactional merge and restart-safe idempotence.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2. Reviewed clean baseline c22345b1ef18335e11df15f4595879464a385f5b. V2-OFFLINE-VOICE-002 is closed/parked partial, not accepted; normal product remains Vosk and candidate stays isolated. This independent CP4 task uses approved2026-09-16 emulator-first D1-D6.

D1: Request READ_CALENDAR only. User explicitly chooses a calendar and finite date range before event preview. No automatic all-account history scan. Cancel/permission denial or revocation does not mutate source or import local notes. Existing text entry remains usable.

D2: Preserve original title, description, stable calendar/event source identity, original date/time zone and recurrence/reminder metadata; title-only event remains importable. One repeating master yields one note, not expanded duplicate notes. Exceptions separately visible/selectable; unsupported recurrence/exception/reminder data retained and labeled unconverted. Preserve original content alongside normal editable note text and category.

D3: Real preview counts for new/already imported/source changed/unconverted/skipped, event selection, editable destination category, explicit confirmation/cancel and clear source-unchanged statement. Imported notes do not enable local reminders or send AI requests.

D4: Source identity plus content fingerprint persists import mappings. Same batch/relaunch/repeated confirmation does not duplicate. Source changes force a new preview; preserve locally edited notes and offer skip or explicit new copy. Similar title/date is not identity. Explain source-ID/account reconstruction ambiguity and require confirmation rather than assert false deduplication. Local batch and mapping writes use one transaction with rollback; stale source/local preview state is rechecked before write, with unavoidable cross-provider snapshot limits explicit.

D5: In dedicated synthetic emulator calendar provider, exercise Chinese/title-only/all-day/timezone/recurring master/exceptions/source edits/deletion/similar titles/permission refusal+revocation/cancel/retry/local edits/relaunch. Test setup can independently create source fixtures, but product manifest and code must not write source calendars. Compare source rows/metadata before and after and exact local content/mapping/category, not just count.

Migrate existing SQLite schema without data loss; preserve notes/drafts/titles/categories/recycle bin/reminders/current backup behavior. New provenance persistence will need later dedicated CP8 compatibility. Clearly state current backup scope if it cannot yet preserve new mapping metadata; do not silently alter existing backup schema or claim whole-data roundtrip. Update product docs and D1-D6 evidence in this task.
out_of_scope: No accounts, calendar creation/source edits, WRITE_CALENDAR in product, cloud sync, private device/calendar access, AI requests, automatic recurrence-to-reminder conversion or enabling imported reminders.
No voice/runtime/model/license work, AI implementation, relations or backup-format expansion. No new third-party dependency without the existing admission gate. No Xiaomi/family acceptance claim.
acceptance: D1-D4 implemented as a usable local import flow: choose bounded source, preview/select/category/confirm, faithful content/provenance, transaction+idempotence and protected existing edits.

D5 actual Android synthetic provider and UI evidence confirms read-only source and correct local results; meaningful host storage/rollback/stale-state tests and affected existing-feature regressions pass, standard offline build/lint pass.

Normal product requests no WRITE_CALENDAR and does not gain candidate ASR dependencies. Private calendar text remains local and absent from logs/fixtures/screenshots except explicitly synthetic test content.

D6 Xiaomi calendar/provider differences and private-data selection remain pending until user final-device phase. Report implemented behavior vs limitations precisely; no assumed provider success or fake import.

contract_body.goal: Implement user-selected read-only Android calendar import into local notes with faithful source provenance, preview, transactional merge and restart-safe idempotence.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2. Reviewed clean baseline c22345b1ef18335e11df15f4595879464a385f5b. V2-OFFLINE-VOICE-002 is closed/parked partial, not accepted; normal product remains Vosk and candidate stays isolated. This independent CP4 task uses approved2026-09-16 emulator-first D1-D6.

D1: Request READ_CALENDAR only. User explicitly chooses a calendar and finite date range before event preview. No automatic all-account history scan. Cancel/permission denial or revocation does not mutate source or import local notes. Existing text entry remains usable.

D2: Preserve original title, description, stable calendar/event source identity, original date/time zone and recurrence/reminder metadata; title-only event remains importable. One repeating master yields one note, not expanded duplicate notes. Exceptions separately visible/selectable; unsupported recurrence/exception/reminder data retained and labeled unconverted. Preserve original content alongside normal editable note text and category.

D3: Real preview counts for new/already imported/source changed/unconverted/skipped, event selection, editable destination category, explicit confirmation/cancel and clear source-unchanged statement. Imported notes do not enable local reminders or send AI requests.

D4: Source identity plus content fingerprint persists import mappings. Same batch/relaunch/repeated confirmation does not duplicate. Source changes force a new preview; preserve locally edited notes and offer skip or explicit new copy. Similar title/date is not identity. Explain source-ID/account reconstruction ambiguity and require confirmation rather than assert false deduplication. Local batch and mapping writes use one transaction with rollback; stale source/local preview state is rechecked before write, with unavoidable cross-provider snapshot limits explicit.

D5: In dedicated synthetic emulator calendar provider, exercise Chinese/title-only/all-day/timezone/recurring master/exceptions/source edits/deletion/similar titles/permission refusal+revocation/cancel/retry/local edits/relaunch. Test setup can independently create source fixtures, but product manifest and code must not write source calendars. Compare source rows/metadata before and after and exact local content/mapping/category, not just count.

Migrate existing SQLite schema without data loss; preserve notes/drafts/titles/categories/recycle bin/reminders/current backup behavior. New provenance persistence will need later dedicated CP8 compatibility. Clearly state current backup scope if it cannot yet preserve new mapping metadata; do not silently alter existing backup schema or claim whole-data roundtrip. Update product docs and D1-D6 evidence in this task.
out_of_scope: No accounts, calendar creation/source edits, WRITE_CALENDAR in product, cloud sync, private device/calendar access, AI requests, automatic recurrence-to-reminder conversion or enabling imported reminders.
No voice/runtime/model/license work, AI implementation, relations or backup-format expansion. No new third-party dependency without the existing admission gate. No Xiaomi/family acceptance claim.
acceptance: D1-D4 implemented as a usable local import flow: choose bounded source, preview/select/category/confirm, faithful content/provenance, transaction+idempotence and protected existing edits.

D5 actual Android synthetic provider and UI evidence confirms read-only source and correct local results; meaningful host storage/rollback/stale-state tests and affected existing-feature regressions pass, standard offline build/lint pass.

Normal product requests no WRITE_CALENDAR and does not gain candidate ASR dependencies. Private calendar text remains local and absent from logs/fixtures/screenshots except explicitly synthetic test content.

Disable/cancel invalidates late output and explains sent text cannot be recalled. Offline,429,5xx, malformed/empty/injected responses preserve notes and saving. Strict bounded response structure, no arbitrary action/script/body-replacement execution. Confirmed HTTPS destination and credential boundaries maintained across redirects; no silent host change, permissive TLS or secret-bearing logs.

I5: Meaningful host and real Android emulator UI tests with clearly labeled synthetic mock service for configuration/consent/outgoing fields, accept/edit/reject, timeout/cancel, stale response, offline/error/invalid content and restart. Product transport is real, mock is evidence only for controlled adapter behavior. Track provider_verified=false if unavailable; do not block independent engineering or claim real AI quality.

Preserve notes/drafts/categories/recycle/reminders/calendar/voice behavior and IDs. Necessary schema migration must be safe. Document current backup exclusions for newly persisted provenance/settings; do not silently expand backup schema. Credentials and temporary suggestions never exported; final CP8 remains separately pending. Add INTERNET only as necessary for explicitly enabled AI path; offline local features stay functional. Prefer current/platform dependencies; any new object requires existing safety gate.

I6: Xiaomi15, user real-service configuration and family testing remain final phase. Provide usable configuration/request/acceptance feature now, plus accurate real-provider condition list. No placeholder AI labeled working, no rule-based fallback marketed as model inference.
out_of_scope: No voice candidate/quality/control work, relations implementation, full-feature backup format change, account/sync/payment/public publishing, cloud ASR, Flutter/KMP or private-device access. No new independent developer task.

No private note transmission or real service request without actual user configuration and testing consent. Do not read unrelated local credentials. No automatically enabled AI or whole-library processing.
